messages:
Marta: Quick design check — on the Create Pool form, do we go inline errors (per-field) or top-level summary + highlight? also a11y question: required marker style (asterisk vs 'Required' label). and destructive confirms: typed confirm vs checkbox for deleting pools.

Ryan: My +1 to inline errors for this form. it's short, users expect field-level guidance. top summary is nice for very long flows though.

Aisha: Inline for field-level validation that blocks submit. For server-side errors, show a persistent top banner. required markers: don't rely on color, use text + asterisk. aria-required gets set on inputs.

Sam: Typed-confirm is good for heavyweight deletes (infra/production). it's higher friction so only for pools with attached deploys or prod tag. For casual deletes, checkbox is fine.

Lee: +1 to conditional typed confirm. Also ensure focus trap and SR announcement when modal opens. keyboard focus should go to the first actionable control.

Marta: Can someone write a short example of the typed-confirm copy we should use? also curious about when inline errors should show (on blur vs on submit).

Design-bot: Proposed copy idea:

Delete pool "training-prod"?
Type the pool name to confirm: `training-prod`

Ryan: small nit: use monospace for the typed token in the UI. and when showing inline errors, link them to the input via `aria-describedby`.

Aisha: accessibility nit: if we keep an asterisk, include offscreen text like "required" so screen readers see it. recommended: visible text "Required" for dense forms, asterisk optional. also set `aria-required="true"`.

Sam: UX nit: showing errors on every blur can be noisy. prefer: show format/validation inline on blur for fields like email, but for required/missing show after first submit attempt.

Marta: Drafting action items: 1) implement inline errors on submit + targeted live validation for format fields (email, quota number) 2) required marker = visible 'Required' label for dense/complex forms; keep asterisk as visual shorthand with offscreen text 3) delete flow: checkbox for empty/non-critical pools, typed confirm for non-empty or prod-tagged pools 4) dev: ensure `aria-describedby` links and focus-first-invalid on submit.

Lee: I'll update the spec doc with the examples and attach aria snippets. ping me for copy review.

Ryan: +1 :thumbsup:

Aisha: one follow-up — what's the keyboard behavior for focusing first invalid field? we should implement focus-to-first-invalid on submit and announce via SR: "Form submission failed: focus moved to first error".

Sam: agreed — we'll add a small utility to focus first invalid and call `announce()` for SR. keep the UX smooth so keyboard users aren't lost.

Marta: Thanks all. I'll open a PR with the copy + the conditional delete rules tomorrow and tag reviewers.
